what_i_did: Concept sheet tools/ranch-rebuild/mj/lamp-kit/sheet.png (concept branch), cut into one crop per piece in views/<piece>/ by the harness target mask. Profiles in build.py are read off those crops in pixels and scaled to metres per piece.

2.22 m. Octagonal lathed iron base (vase, collars, rings), round shaft, a 6-sided swept crook ending in a curl, two links, a 4-sided lantern (flared pyramid roof, bulging glass with corner bars, floor, knob). LightAnchor at the glass centre (0.49, 0, 1.31).
1.50 m. Jittered square timber post with a sloped top, iron cup and plate, 4-sided egg-shaped glass with corner bars, flared roof and top ring. LightAnchor at (0, 0, 1.18).
0.47 m. Hexagonal wall plate (back face on y = 0, wall at +Y), boss, swan-neck arm, 6-sided lantern hanging at y = -0.20. Origin at the plate centre. LightAnchor at (0, -0.20, -0.10).
Two rough timber posts 2.42 and 2.38 m, 2.5 m apart, with a slight lean, dark straps, a cable sagging 0.32 m and four bulbs on sockets. LightAnchor_1..4 left to right at the bulb centres.

Iron_Black #2e251f (iron, cable, straps, sockets), Timber_Warm #643a24, Glass_Warm #ffc56b with the same emissive (strength 1; the game drives it). Glass_Warm is on glass and bulbs only. Smooth shading with split normals at 50 deg (timber 35 deg), flat colours, no textures.
good: Porch lamp IoU 0.822 from a calibrated 45 deg camera (the sheet draws it three-quarter).
off: String lights score 0.016 at the specified 2.5 m spacing: the sheet's posts are about 1.63 m apart for their 2.4 m height, and thin posts in the wrong place give almost no overlap. The same model at the sheet spacing (LAMP_SPAN=1.63) scores 0.592.
The crook's foot plate cast shadow is counted as object in the target mask (the rows near the ground are wider than the plate), which costs the crook a little.
No candle or flame inside the glass, no wood grain, knots or iron hammer marks: flat colours only.

The sheet's post lantern is as tall as the crook (about 2.2 m at the crook's scale). It is built at the specified 1.5 m with the sheet's proportions scaled uniformly, so the lantern is small for its post compared with the crook.

rounds.change: First build of all four from eyeballed crop measurements.
Crook base and crook path re-measured from the target mask rows; octagon turned so a vertex faces +-X; lantern roof flare. Porch scored from a calibrated three-quarter camera (view_check.py).

Crook cut to budget (6-sided crook tube, lighter links, fewer base rings). Porch arm spline-smoothed and thickened, knob moved onto the plate. String lights: lean reduced, bulbs closer to the cable, checked at the sheet span.

moving_parts: None. The game drives the Glass_Warm emissive and places lights at the LightAnchor nodes.
